g.text: FarField: Grounded Jumps and Branch-Scoped Evolution
Proposed framework · Real observations inform future research and reusable capabilities
Stable intent and constraints; revisable scientific subquestions
Model drafts; sources check changes and limits
State assumptions, alternatives and failure conditions
Check related methods, negative results and scope
Design a cheap test; keep implementation open
Investigate further / revise the landing / defer
Jump when needed; refine locally using real findings
Explore freely; freeze the protocol for confirmation
Write methods, access data, construct measurements
Independent native evaluator + code and raw results
Real environment and observations ≠ internal rollout
Check implementation, intervention and test validity
Cite results: retain / revise / test further / pause
Prediction error alone does not refute a hypothesis
Findings, failure boundaries and unresolved questions
Source observations, scope and evidence dependencies
Reusable analysis code and experimental procedures
Evolve research capabilities; keep shared rules fixed
Fork a fixed snapshot; evolve separately
Shared read-only sources; isolated learning updates
Evidence-linked memory and skills guide the next question, experiment or jump
Retracted evidence triggers dependency review; retaining a justified belief is allowed
Literature & data · Isolated execution · Independent evaluation · Event ledger & dependencies · Budget
Valuable directions, independently validated outcomes, and better subsequent research
Solid: existing foundations requiring further work. Dashed: executable skill lifecycle and frozen learning snapshots to be completed.
Skills currently remain prompt advice; the full loop, prediction calibration and research benefits are not yet established.
